LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin.label: Suiyin
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin.description: Suiyin records the Ratkin, famines, and plagues your colony meets, then answers what has already happened. She does not decide for you.\n\nHer pace is close to Randy's. Famine incidents sit on top of that, so the game is harder overall. Her trust in this colony changes how often major threats reach a home map: high trust spaces them out, low trust packs them in. A single threat still follows the difficulty and its random swing.
